description:
Update the properties of a checklistItem object.

💡 TIP: Updates a step (checklist item) of a To Do task. Use this to check a step off (body: { isChecked: true }), uncheck it (isChecked: false), or rename it (displayName). Requires checklistItemId from list-todo-checklist-items.

anyOf.description: The date and time when the checklistItem was finished.

checkedDateTime.description: The date and time when the checklistItem was finished.

createdDateTime.description: The date and time when the checklistItem was created.

displayName.description: Indicates the title of the checklistItem.

id.description: The unique identifier for an entity. Read-only.

isChecked.description: State that indicates whether the item is checked off or not.

checklistItemId.description: Value for the 'checklistItemId' path segment. Pass it under the name 'checklistItemId', not as 'id'. Use the 'id' field of the checklist item object as returned by Microsoft Graph.

confirm.description: For destructive operations when the confirm gate is enabled (MS365_MCP_REQUIRE_CONFIRM=true; off by default). Set to true only after the user has explicitly approved this action. When the gate is on, calls without confirm: true return { error: "confirmation_required" } without touching user data.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure indication

includeHeaders.description: Include response headers (including ETag) in the response metadata

todoTaskId.description: Value for the 'todoTaskId' path segment. Pass it under the name 'todoTaskId', not as 'id'. Use the 'id' field of the todo task object as returned by Microsoft Graph.

todoTaskListId.description: Value for the 'todoTaskListId' path segment. Pass it under the name 'todoTaskListId', not as 'id'. Use the 'id' field of the todo task list object as returned by Microsoft Graph.

name: update-todo-checklist-item
